title: Troubled Tributary: Maryland's Patuxent River
description: A documentary about the Patuxent River. I was an Associate Producer on the project, which aired on Maryland Public Television in 2022 as a part of Chesapeake Bay Week.

title: Intuitive Physics in VR
description: A research project exploring how to humans interact with. digital materials in virtual reality. Advised by Dr. Bei Xiao at American University and presented at Capital Graphics 2022.

title: Space Ocean Library
description: An immersive film on memory and loss. Presented at UFVA (University Film and Video Association) conference in 2022 in association with the Insitute for IDEAS at American University.
